title: Cu CMP low slurry-flow excursion
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: slurry flow trends down, endpoint time extends, and Cu residue rises across several wafers. Root cause: Partial restriction in the slurry filter reduced delivered slurry flow. Corrective actions: replace the slurry filter; calibrate the flow controller; run qualification wafers. Engineering boundary: Do not release held lots until post-maintenance flow and removal-rate checks pass

title: Cu CMP intermittent slurry-delivery loss
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: intermittent slurry-flow dips align with removal-rate loss and endpoint extension. Root cause: Slurry pump cavitation intermittently interrupted chemical delivery. Corrective actions: inspect pump inlet pressure; remove trapped gas; verify stable slurry delivery. Engineering boundary: Treat the pump mechanism as unconfirmed until pressure and flow traces correlate

title: Cu CMP radial scratch cluster
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: radial scratches repeat at the same wafer radius while normal slurry and endpoint signals are observed. Root cause: A worn retaining ring created repeatable mechanical contact. Corrective actions: replace the retaining ring; inspect carrier contact surfaces; verify scratch-free monitor wafers. Engineering boundary: Do not attribute isolated random scratches to the retaining ring without repeatable geometry

title: Cu CMP random scratch burst
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: random-direction scratches appear on a short wafer sequence after a carrier change with normal process traces. Root cause: A trapped carrier particle caused transient wafer contact. Corrective actions: clean the carrier; inspect the load path; monitor subsequent wafers. Engineering boundary: The exact particle source remains inconclusive without physical recovery

title: Cu CMP center-fast thickness profile
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: post-polish thickness shows a center-fast profile while slurry flow remains stable. Root cause: Pad glazing changed the effective wafer-to-pad contact profile. Corrective actions: condition or replace the pad; verify pad-life counters; run profile qualification. Engineering boundary: Confirm with pad condition and profile evidence before changing pressure recipes

title: Cu CMP edge over-polish signature
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: edge thickness loss increases after carrier maintenance while center removal remains nominal. Root cause: Retaining-ring pressure calibration was biased high. Corrective actions: recalibrate ring pressure; check carrier maintenance records; qualify edge profile. Engineering boundary: Recipe changes require process-engineer approval after hardware calibration is verified

title: ILD CVD low deposition rate
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: pre-CMP ILD thickness drifts low on one chamber while downstream CMP traces remain normal. Root cause: The precursor mass-flow controller calibration drifted low. Corrective actions: calibrate the precursor MFC; check chamber matching; run thickness qualification. Engineering boundary: Do not blame CMP when upstream pre-CMP thickness is already low

title: CVD chamber particle burst
content: Synthetic RCA case. Observed symptom: particle counts rise abruptly after long chamber runtime and show chamber-specific clustering. Root cause: Deposited film flaked from the showerhead after exceeding clean life. Corrective actions: perform chamber clean; inspect the showerhead; reset and monitor clean-life counters. Engineering boundary: Hold chamber-exposed lots until particle monitors pass

title: PECVD film-stress shift

Root cause: RF matching-network drift changed plasma ion energy. Corrective actions: verify RF match tuning; inspect reflected power; qualify film stress. Engineering boundary: Stress evidence alone cannot authorize an RF hardware replacement

title: CVD wafer-to-wafer rate drift

Root cause: The post-clean chamber seasoning sequence was incomplete. Corrective actions: repeat the seasoning sequence; verify rate stabilization; review PM completion checks. Engineering boundary: Exclude unstable seasoning wafers from production release

title: CVD center-edge thickness imbalance

title: Lithography CD large excursion

title: Lithography overlay X shift

title: Lithography missing-pattern strip

title: Lithography bridge-defect increase

title: Plasma etch-rate loss

title: Etch microtrenching increase

title: Ion implant dose-low excursion

title: Ion implant angle asymmetry

title: Implanter endstation particle event

title: Anneal sheet-resistance high

title: Furnace oxygen-precipitate increase

title: Furnace boat-slot periodic defects

title: PVD metal sheet-resistance drift

title: PVD interface-void increase

Engineering boundary: Void morphology and preclean evidence are required before changing deposition

title: PVD chamber particle excursion

title: PVD left-right thickness asymmetry

title: Wet-clean watermark excursion

title: Wet-clean metallic contamination
